whenToUse: Passing an item along inside a messenger or collaboration tool.
Sending to several people at once.
The recipients are inside the app.
whenNotToUse: Sending outside the app (use a share sheet).
Posting again to your own feed (use a repost).

alternatives.name: Share Sheet
alternatives.reason: Sending to apps on the device.

alternatives.name: Repost
alternatives.reason: Posting again to your own feed.

accessibility: The recipient list is a fieldset of checkboxes.
The search and message fields have names.
When there's no one to send to, the button is disabled.
The result is announced with role=status.
